# stevo.ai - Stephen M Abbott

> Stephen Abbott's personal site: background, projects, and résumé.
> Owner of Wire Hold. Cybersecurity and AI are the day job; the projects
> include software, games, commerce, and things he builds for fun.

Stephen M Abbott is a cybersecurity and AI executive with 16 years in
enterprise technology and 12 in cybersecurity, including director-level work
at Fortune 100 scale leading a security engineering organization of up to 26
engineers. His career record includes a 92% reduction in sensitive-data
findings, more than 75% fewer open-source dependencies, and 99.99% availability
for critical transaction platforms.
